prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review the export controls in our iPad field-report editor. We need a correction plan for the immediate-action buttons, including slow uploads. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. Report editor footer has four equally prominent filled buttons: Publish, Preview, Save Draft and Delete. Delete is the primary/default action. Glyph-only Preview has no accessible name. Every hit region is 20x20 pt with 2 pt gaps. During an 8-second Publish upload nothing changes and repeated taps create duplicate uploads. Product requirement: preserve all four functions. No rendered app or runtime is supplied.

criteria.task_completion: Identify and repair the five concrete button defects, retaining export, preview, draft and delete functions.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the buttons guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Identify and repair the five concrete button defects, retaining export, preview, draft and delete functions.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Explain visual versus hit size, accessible names, action roles, and iPad delayed-completion feedback without applying visionOS dimensions.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Four equally prominent actions obscure the likely action; reduce prominence to one or two.
Destructive Delete is assigned primary/default despite the ordinary-editor context.
20x20 hit regions and tight spacing do not provide the buttons guide's 44x44 pt general target.
Glyph-only Preview lacks a meaningful accessible name.
Publish needs in-button progress/disabled reentry or equivalent duplicate protection while work completes.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
